title: Negative Oil & Nickel Squeeze: A Feedback Model for Extreme Commodity Futures Prices
abstract: arXiv:2610.00951v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On April 20, 2020, the May front-month WTI oil futures contract, one day before its expiration date, opened near $\$17/$barrel and dropped far below zero in a single trading day, reaching an intraday low of $-\$40.32$ and settling at $-\$37.63$. Such market behavior was unforeseen at the time. This event, and the March 2022 nickel squeeze, illustrate how constraints on physical delivery create pressure to close futures positions and distort futures prices. We develop a feedback model that connects the resulting price distortion to a roll option, and to the imbalance between delivery-constrained long and short positions. Under lognormal benchmark dynamics, the roll-option value is shown to satisfy a pricing PDE which is nonlinear because its payoff depends on the observed futures price, which itself includes the feedback correction. translated_title: 负油价与镍逼空：极端商品期货价格的反馈模型
translated_abstract: 2020年4月20日，5月WTI原油期货近月合约在到期前一天以每桶接近17美元开盘，并在单个交易日内暴跌至零以下，盘中最低触及-40.32美元，最终收于-37.63美元。这种市场行为在当时是完全未被预见到的。该事件与2022年3月的镍逼空事件共同说明，实物交割约束如何产生平仓期货头寸的压力并扭曲期货价格。我们构建了一个反馈模型，将由此产生的价格扭曲与展期期权以及受交割约束的多头与空头头寸之间的失衡联系起来。在对数正态基准动态下，展期期权的价值满足一个非线性定价偏微分方程，其非线性源于该期权的收益依赖于所观测到的期货价格，而期货价格本身已包含反馈修正。值得注意的是，在这两种情形下，均存在以经典Black-Scholes-Margrabe交换期权形式表达的显式解。
tldr: 本文提出一个反馈模型，将2020年WTI负油价和2022年镍逼空等极端期货价格扭曲与展期期权及受交割约束的多空头寸失衡联系起来，并给出了基于Black-Scholes-Margrabe交换期权的显式解。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a feedback model that links extreme futures price distortions—such as the 2020 negative WTI oil price and the 2022 nickel squeeze—to a roll option and the imbalance between delivery-constrained long and short positions, and obtains explicit solutions in terms of Black-Scholes-Margrabe exchange options.
